title: Sets a consistent starting width for flexible items
goal: Understand flex-basis sets item dimensions before flex space is allocated.
summary: The old width of the two titles in the flow bar is different. Unify their initial sizes so that the step prompts fill the remaining width.
tasks: Let the .phase items each start with a width of 104px and maintain that width.
